Material Authenticity & Prime Virgin PP 05","text":"All Ace Packaging plastic food storage containers (including Hinge Cups, Portion Cups, RO-Series, RE-Series Bento Boxes, ZEN Series, Natraj Containers, and Deli Tubs) are manufactured exclusively from 100% prime virgin Polypropylene (PP 05). We do not blend regrind or post-consumer plastic into direct food-contact surfaces. All manufacturing and resins comply with certified ISO 9001:2015 standards.","bullets":[],"closing":""},{"title":"2. Sample Evaluations & Kitchen Testing","text":"Ace Packaging provides physical sample kits to verified corporate buyers, cloud kitchens, and brand owners to evaluate thermal performance (-20°C deep freeze to +120°C microwave), lid snap tolerances, stackability, and zero-leak integrity under transit. Sample evaluation carries no binding wholesale obligation.","bullets":[],"closing":""},{"title":"3. Dispatch, Packaging & Freight Tolerances","text":"Containers are hygienically sleeved in dust-free poly bags and packed in export-grade heavy-duty corrugated cartons to prevent rim deformation during transit:","bullets":["Domestic Dispatch (India): Ex-factory Daman or delivered via trusted freight partners.","Global Exports (UAE, Middle East, Europe, Australia, Americas): Standard FCL/LCL ocean freight from Nhava Sheva (JNPT) / Hazira Port under Incoterms (FOB, CIF, CFR).","Carton Quantities: Standard packing counts (e.g. 240, 250, 500, or 1,000 pcs per carton) are specified per model datasheet."],"closing":""},{"title":"4.
